description: This header file defines interfaces and data structures related to mailmap handling in a version control system, including function prototypes for reading and clearing mailmap data, as well as mapping user email addresses and names.

methods.name: read_mailmap_file
methods.description: Reads mailmap data from a file specified by filename with given flags.

methods.name: read_mailmap_blob
methods.description: Reads mailmap data from a blob source.

methods.name: read_mailmap
methods.description: Reads mailmap data from a default or preconfigured source.

methods.name: map_user
methods.description: Maps a user's email and name to their canonical forms based on the mailmap.
